description: This Java class, ThingsSseRouteBuilder, provides the implementation for building Akka HTTP routes that support Server Sent Events (SSE) for /things and /search endpoints within an Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It manages route configuration, authorization, streaming lifecycle, and event processing for SSE connections.

classes.name: ThingsSseRouteBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating Akka HTTP routes that support Server Sent Events (SSE) for /things and /search endpoints, with configurable authorization, supervision, and event processing.

classes.name: NoOpSseAuthorizationEnforcer
classes.description: Null implementation of the SseAuthorizationEnforcer interface, performing no actual authorization checks.

classes.name: NoOpSseConnectionSupervisor
classes.description: Null implementation of the SseConnectionSupervisor interface, supervising streams without any specific logic.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ThingsSseRouteBuilder with provided streaming actor, config, and pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: withAuthorizationEnforcer
methods.description: Sets a custom authorization enforcer for the SSE routes.

methods.name: withEventSniffer
methods.description: Sets a custom event sniffer for debugging or logging.

methods.name: withSseConnectionSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor responsible for supervising SSE streams.

methods.name: withSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Sets the signal enrichment provider used during event processing.

methods.name: withProxyActor
methods.description: Configures a proxy actor for certain operations.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the Akka HTTP route rendering /things and /search SSE endpoints with the current configuration.

methods.name: buildThingsSseRoute
methods.description: Creates the SSE route for /things, including authorization and parameter handling.

methods.name: createSseRoute
methods.description: Creates the SSE route for /things, handling parameters, authorization, and stream lifecycle.

methods.name: createSearchSseRoute
methods.description: Creates the SSE route for /search endpoint, including search-specific parameters and proxy handling.

methods.name: postprocess
methods.description: Post-processes JSON events, enriching and filtering as needed before sending to clients.

methods.name: namespaceMatches
methods.description: Checks if an event's namespace matches provided list.

methods.name: targetThingIdMatches
methods.description: Checks if an event's entity ID matches target IDs.

methods.name: toNonemptyThingJson
methods.description: Converts a Thing and event to JSON, filtering empty results.

methods.name: getNamespaces
methods.description: Parses namespace parameter into list.

methods.name: getThingIds
methods.description: Parses comma-separated string into list of ThingId.

methods.name: getFieldSelector
methods.description: Creates a JsonFieldSelector from string.

methods.name: namespaceFromId
methods.description: Extracts namespace from a ThingEvent's entity ID.

methods.name: newAcceptHeaderExtractor
methods.description: Creates a partial function to extract 'Accept' header for text/event-stream media type.

methods.name: matchesTextEventStream
methods.description: Checks if an Accept header indicates a text event stream.

methods.name: getCounterFor
methods.description: Creates a metrics Counter with relevant tags for SSE counting.
